push.title: W 4-0 vs Gerth United | You: 9.4 (first match performance of the season)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, a 9.4 against Gerth United. I'd hug you, but I'd probably cry on your jersey.

THE GOOD
+ 2 key passes. Every key pass is a love letter to a teammate.
+ A brace against Gerth United. Defenders can draw up all the plans they want; you just scored anyway.
+ Man of the Match. Frame it, then hang it where your mama can see it.
+ That connection with PhogsToffees is the real deal. Find 'em early and often.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. That right there is what good teammates do.

THE BAD
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Try this: Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal. Practice makes permanent.
- 67% passing (14 of 21). One more thing: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too. Keep it simple, keep it sweet.
- BellyTb1 struggled with defensive work rate too. Work on it as a pair: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- 3 shots off target cost 0.1. Think before the touch.

Pre-match routine: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.

tuxedo_slide, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: A coach's whistle is just a fancy way of saying 'I care.'

You played with joy, and joy is contagious. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
PhogsToffees, your 2nd best match performance of the season at 8.7. Good as gold.

THE GOOD
+ 7 shots at Gerth United's goal. You kept knocking on that door like a Girl Scout with a quota.
+ 1 key pass. That's playmaking, plain and simple.
+ You and tuxedo_slide were on the same wavelength, like two radios tuned to the good station.
+ Your 2nd best match performance of the season: 8.7. That's the standard now.
+ Team-high 4 tackles attempted. That's the stuff I want framed.

THE BAD
- 1 of 7 shots on target. Fundamentals: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is. You're closer than you think.
- You and tuxedo_slide can fix forcing passes as a duo: give each other short options.
- Most missed tackles on the team: 3 (best was tuxedo_slide's 2). Low-hanging fruit: Show them down the line, toward the touchline and away from goal, then strike.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 47%, down from your usual 74%. That's the kind of thing that gets you benched on a real team. Bread and butter: Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.

Repetition station: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

Listen here, PhogsToffees: Believe it, then go do it.

I'm gonna go tell my plant about you. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-0 vs Gerth United | You: 7.8 (3rd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
BellyTb1, your 3rd best match performance of the season with a 7.8. We can build on that.

THE GOOD
+ A goal against Gerth United. You found the corner like it owed you rent.
+ Your 3rd best match performance of the season, at 7.8. Every season needs a few of these.
+ Part of a 4-0 beating of Gerth United. Enjoy it. Then go get the next one.
+ Their humans averaged 6.7 to our 8.6; we out-played them man for man. Put that in the team scrapbook.

THE BAD
- 63% passing (12 of 19). Golden rule: Simple and on the ground to the open, facing teammate. Driven and lofted balls are for clear lanes only. That's a coach's honest word.
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Tell you what: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.
- 1 goal from 3 on target. Easy money: Side-foot for accuracy inside the box; power is for outside it. No sweat, just reps.
- tuxedo_slide had the same defensive work rate gremlin. Squash it together: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 7.8 (best was tuxedo_slide's 9.4). That's not you at your best, and we both know it.

Rondo time: Count your touches. Two-touch is a habit that keeps your head up and the ball moving.

One thought for the road, BellyTb1: You miss every pass you don't make, and some you do. Make 'em anyway.

Ups and downs make a roller coaster, and roller coasters are fun. - Coach Lasso
